title: Crispy Portuguese Chicken Skewers
description: Delicious and easy-to-make skewers, perfect for a quick dinner. The crispy exterior and juicy interior of the chicken will make your taste buds dance.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, egg, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Dip each chicken piece into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Dip the flour-coated chicken piece into the beaten egg, making sure to coat completely.
Roll the egg-coated chicken piece in the Portuguese bread crumbs, pressing the crumbs onto the chicken to help them stick.
Place the coated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the tops of the chicken pieces with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder, if using.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the exterior is crispy.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
